# Tidyleaf

> Tidyleaf makes small, privacy-first Chrome extensions that do one job well: no account, no tracking, and no user data collected. Each extension has a free tier and an optional Tidyleaf Pro upgrade. They run in desktop Chrome. All five are submitted to the Chrome Web Store and pending review, so none can be installed from the store yet; each landing page will link its listing once approved. Firefox and Edge versions are planned.

Tidyleaf Pro is $24 a year or $3.99 a month, and one license key unlocks Pro in every Tidyleaf extension. The free features stay free.

## Extensions

- [Tidyleaf AI Chat Exporter](https://tidyleaf.github.io/ai-chat-exporter): Exports ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini conversations to Markdown, plain text, JSON or PDF, with an Export button on each site. Free: exports of the open conversation. Pro ($24 a year or $3.99 a month): bulk export of all chats as a zip of Markdown files (chatgpt.com and claude.ai), Obsidian export and Notion export.
- [Tidyleaf Folders for ChatGPT and Claude](https://tidyleaf.github.io/chatgpt-claude-folders): Adds folders, pins and fast title search to the sidebar of ChatGPT and Claude; folders are stored in your browser only. Free: up to 5 folders, pins and title search. Pro ($24 a year or $3.99 a month): unlimited folders, search inside messages and folder export to a Markdown zip.
- [Tidyleaf Form Filler](https://tidyleaf.github.io/form-filler-extension): Fills any web form in one click from profiles saved on your device, with no daily limit and no account; never fills passwords or card numbers. Free: 1 profile and 3 site rules. Pro ($24 a year or $3.99 a month): unlimited profiles and site rules, JSON backup and restore, CSV import and smart values.
- [Tidyleaf Dual Subtitles for Netflix](https://tidyleaf.github.io/netflix-dual-subtitles): Shows two subtitle lines on netflix.com at once (the title's own subtitles, machine translation only when a language is missing), in 17 languages including Traditional and Simplified Chinese, with pinyin or zhuyin. Free: two lines, every language, pinyin and zhuyin, with no trial timer. Needs your own Netflix subscription. Pro ($24 a year or $3.99 a month): SRT download, click-to-save words and a saved-words page with CSV export for Anki.
- [Tidyleaf Dual Subtitles for YouTube](https://tidyleaf.github.io/youtube-dual-subtitles): Shows the video's captions plus a translation on two lines, in 17 languages including Traditional and Simplified Chinese, with pinyin or zhuyin. Free: dual subtitles on videos and Shorts, every language, pinyin and zhuyin, no time limit. Pro ($24 a year or $3.99 a month): SRT download, click-to-save words and a saved-words page with CSV export for Anki.

## Privacy policies

- [AI Chat Exporter privacy policy](https://tidyleaf.github.io/chat-exporter/privacy): Collects no data; chats stay on your device. Only the Pro license key goes to Polar, to check it.
